criteria: support requires validate Brier AND log-loss better than both baselines, and validate flagged hit rate > 0.524 with cluster t >= 2

events: player-games with minutes>0 and >=10 prior played games, stats pts/reb/ast/fg3m, target = over
hypothesis: Combined split-card P(over) (beta-binomial shrink of each split toward season-baseline, n-weighted log-odds average) has lower Brier and log-loss than the naive last-10 hit rate and the season hit rate, and flagged sides (P>=0.58 over, or P<=0.42 i.e. under >=0.58) hit above the -110 breakeven 0.524.
metrics: flagged-side hit rate vs 0.524 with t (naive, events are correlated within player-day) and player-day cluster-robust t
point_in_time: only games strictly before the game's ET date; teammate status = played the team's previous game; defence rank = opponent allowed-per-game this season before the date
synthetic_line: line = median of the player's prior 10 games of the stat, rounded to x.5 (floor(median)+0.5). LIMITATION: no free historical prop lines exist; synthetic lines are not real prices, so this tests forecasting skill only, never betting edge.

decision: forecast-skill only; stays research/watchlist. Explore fails vs season rate; flagged hit rate is a synthetic-line artifact (unders); tails overconfident
